about: Hand-made travel vlog: driving filler, a cheap-hotel story, a pleasant but flat beach day.

segments.text: Good morning from the car, we are driving to the coast.
Traffic is terrible but the snacks are great.
We booked the cheapest hotel we could find.
Forty dollars a night, which should have been a warning.
So we finally get there and check in.
And the lady at the desk just laughs at us.
We open the door to our room.
The bed is inside the bathroom.
Not next to the bathroom. Inside it.
There is a shower curtain around the bed.
I'm never booking anything cheap again.
Anyway, the beach the next day was gorgeous.
The water was crystal clear and warm.
We swam until the sun went down.
Then we grabbed fish tacos from a little stand.
Best tacos of the whole trip, easily.

good.why: cheapest hotel, bed in the bathroom
